questions.text: It is 2026-11-09 and this lost 1R: Brent went through 98.0. What happened? Name at least one reason that is a thesis error, not luck. (Random entries with your target and stop hit the stop first 38.3% of the time.)

The source of this idea is consensus, while managed money sits at only the 17th percentile on your side: what is your own edge here beyond agreeing with the consensus view, and would you still take it if the consensus were not saying it?
